No outer on the round table. One straight row of beanies with the head forms in the middle, so the height peaks at the centre.圓形枱不放外套。冷帽排成一直行，頭模放在中間，令高度在中央最高。

HEIGHT高度
Head forms at the back or the centre, flat product in front. Nothing in front may hide the form behind it.頭模放後方或中央，平放貨品放前方。前方的貨品不可遮擋後面的頭模。
EARS貓耳
Every cat ear points up and stays open. Stuff the crown with balloon stuffing so the ear holds its shape on a flat-laid beanie.所有貓耳必須向上並保持挺立。平放的冷帽要用填充棉（balloon stuffing）填充帽頂，令貓耳定型。
LOGOLOGO
Every team logo faces the aisle and sits square - LA, NY, SOX and B all upright, none rotated.所有球隊 logo 朝向通道並保持端正 — LA、NY、SOX、B 全部正放，不可歪斜。
EVEN SPACING平均間距
A hand's width between pieces, the same gap all the way round. If your table is fuller than the demo, take product off rather than close the gaps.貨品之間相隔約一個手掌闊度，整圈間距一致。如果枱面比示範擁擠，應減少貨品，不要收窄間距。

FIXTURE道具
One curved floor hanger or round hanger. Fit the number of down jackets to the length of the fixture in your store - the nine in the render are an example, not a quantity to hit.一個弧形地架或圓形衣架。羽絨外套數量請按店內道具的長度調整 — 圖中九件只作示例，並非必須掛足的數量。
FACE THE AISLE正掛朝通道
01 and 02 both hang front-facing and carry tags, 02 directly behind 01, so the customer meets a full garment first. Everything from 03 on hangs side-on - every row in the list says which.01 及 02 都是正掛並掛上吊牌，02 掛在 01 正後方，令顧客首先看到完整外套。由 03 起全部側掛 — 清單上每一行都有註明。
GROUP BY STYLE按款號分組
Hang the colourways of one style together, and run pale to dark inside each group. Grouping by style is what keeps the two pinks and the two blacks apart.同一款號的所有顏色掛在一起，每組之內由淺色排到深色。按款號分組，自然就把兩款粉紅及兩款黑色分開。
TAG THE RIGHT JACKET吊牌對應外套
The jacket printed on the hanger tag must be the jacket it hangs on. Check the style code before you hang it, not just the colour.吊牌上印的外套必須與所掛的外套相同。掛之前請核對款號，不要只看顏色。
SPACING間距
Even gaps, all hangers hooked the same way round, every zip closed and every collar standing.間距平均，所有衣架同一方向掛好，所有拉鏈拉上，所有衣領企起。

Hanger Tag — Mix & Match

吊牌 — 配搭對照

Nine tags. Each one shows a down jacket with the beanie that goes with it — the tag is how the customer sees the pairing on the rail. Tap a tag to enlarge.
九款吊牌。每款展示一件羽絨外套及其配搭的冷帽 — 顧客就是靠吊牌看到這個配搭。點擊吊牌可放大。

ONE PER PIECE每件一個
Every down jacket on the floor hanger carries one tag.地架上每件羽絨外套都要掛一個吊牌。
MATCH THE ART對應稿件
Hang the tag whose jacket colour matches the jacket it is on. The tag shows the customer the beanie that goes with it.吊牌上的外套顏色必須與所掛的外套一致。吊牌是用來告訴顧客配搭哪一頂冷帽。
POSITION位置
The cord loops over the hanger hook above the collar and both ends run down through the hole, so the card hangs centred on the chest with its top edge just below the collar - roughly a quarter of the way down the garment. Do not lay the card over the shoulder.繩圈套在衣領上方的衣架鈎，兩端經孔位垂下，吊牌垂在胸前正中，頂邊剛好在衣領下方 — 約在外套四分之一位置。不可將吊牌搭在膊頭上。

Hanger Tag Cord — Setup

吊牌繩 — 安裝方法

The cord is settled - no other cord, colour or ribbon is to be used on these tags. The production card prints on both sides, so there is no blank face: the knot shows whichever way the tag turns, and has to be small and tidy.
繩款已確定，請勿自行更換其他繩款、顏色或緬帶。正式吊牌兩面都有印刷，沒有空白面 — 無論哪一面向外都會見到個結，所以結要打得細小整齊。

Tap either photograph to enlarge點擊相片可放大

How it goes on安裝方法

  1. Thread the cord through the punched hole at the top of the card, between the two cat ears.將繩穿過吊牌頂部兩隻貓耳之間的孔。
  2. Tie the knot at the hole and pull it tight, so it sits small and flat against the card. Trim the cut end short.在孔位打結並拉緊，令結細小平貼吊牌。繩尾剪短。
  3. The card is printed on both sides, so the knot is visible either way. Keep it neat and clear of the artwork - do not use tape or staples.吊牌兩面都有印刷，無論哪一面都會見到個結。請打得整齊，不要遮著印刷 — 亦不可用膠紙或訂書釘。
  4. Slip the loop over the hanger hook, above the collar - not over the shoulder of the jacket.把繩圈套在衣架鉤上，位置在衣領之上 — 不要搭在外套肩部。
  5. Let the card hang centred on the chest, its top edge just below the collar - about a quarter of the way down the jacket.吊牌垂在胸前正中，頂邊剛好在衣領下方 — 約在外套四分之一位置。
  6. Cut every cord to the same length, so the whole rail of tags hangs at one height. Do not let one tag sit higher than the next.所有吊繩必須剪成相同長度，令整排吊牌高度一致。不可有的高、有的低。

Round twisted cord · art. 402406001 · HK$16 / roll

03

Entrance POP門口 POP

PLACEMENT位置
At the entrance on the door line, on the side the customer enters from, so it is read before the first fixture.放在門口大門位置、顧客入口那一邊，令顧客在看到第一組陳列前先看到它。
HEIGHT高度
Artwork centre at eye level. Do not stand it on the floor and do not mount it above the door header.稿件中心與視線同高。不可直接放在地上，亦不可裝在門楣之上。

Before You Open開店前檢查

  1. Table dressed to the demo for your table shape - hexagon or round.按你店舖的枱形（六角形或圓形）跟足示範陳列。
  2. MEOW POP up, one per table.MEOW POP 已放好，每張枱一個。
  3. All cat ears standing, crowns stuffed with balloon stuffing.所有貓耳企起，帽頂已用填充棉填充。
  4. Every logo square and facing the aisle.所有 logo 端正並朝向通道。
  5. One hanger tag on every down jacket on the floor hanger.地架上每件羽絨外套都掛了一個吊牌。
  6. Tag artwork matches the jacket it hangs on.吊牌稿件與所掛的外套一致。
  7. Every tag cord cut to the same length.所有吊繩已剪成相同長度。
  8. Entrance POP up at the door line, eye level, clean and flat.門口 POP 已放在大門位置，與視線同高，清潔平整。
